_metadata.description: General analytics/marketing patterns not covered by WebAppAnalyzer base
_metadata.notes: Higher-ed specific patterns moved to higher-ed-*.json files. UNI-237 code-review fix also parked 'Angular' here even though it is not analytics/marketing: its base definition lives in the generated (build-artifact) file, which scripts/lint-generated.js hard-blocks hand-editing; the pattern-overrides.json layer can only REMOVE evidence, not rewrite a regex. 'ng-app' needed a rewrite (bare 'ng-app' was 87% false positive, colliding with prose like 'engineeri[ng-app]lied'), not a removal -- removal alone would have cost 5 real detections (measured against the corpus) that a tightened regex does not. lint-generated.js's own guidance for a change that is neither a removal nor a category fix is 'move the technology into a curated patterns/higher-ed-*.json' -- this is the closest existing non-higher-ed curated file. There is no dedicated general-frameworks file; creating one was judged out of scope for this fix.

Matomo.description: Matomo (formerly Piwik) open-source web analytics. Self-hosted; detectable via script path and _paq JS array.
